text:
jamal: Heads-up — planning to unpin runtime v2.14.1 for quant models (llm-quant) in tonight's 00:00 UTC change window. target: low-risk gradual roll (canary -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%).

deploybot: Scheduled unpin job created for 2025-03-23 00:00:00 UTC. Canary region: eu-west-1, initial traffic 5%. Notifying on #eng-oncall.

maria: Question: what's the rollback trigger set? last time we rolled back on a 0.8% error-rate blip.

jamal: Rollback triggers: >1% 5m error rate OR latency p99 increase >200ms over baseline OR model mismatch errors (KV cache failures). If any of these, auto-stop and notify.

kevin: SDK note — are we sure client SDK v3.2.0 is safe with the unpinned runtime? there was a header change in 3.2.0-beta.

jamal: Good call. We validated against 3.2.0-stable yesterday. 3.2.0-beta not allowed on production. We'll add a preflight that rejects requests with unknown header signatures.

alisa: Can we start a small internal canary (mobile-app traffic only) for 30m before public canary? reduces blast radius.

prashant: +1 to alisa. Suggest: internal canary -> eu-west public 5% -> global 25%. Also recommend enabling kv-cache telemetry for first 2h.

deploybot: Canary started (eu-west-1) — 5% traffic routed. Canary health checks OK (3m). Telemetry pipeline: kv-cache hits 98.7% baseline.

maria: Seeing a single model mismatch in logs (probable config drift). Jamal can you check model shard mapping?

jamal: On it, looking at shard map. quick fix: push missing alias mapping to routing table; pushing in 30s.

jamal: Alias mapping pushed. deploybot: confirmed route update applied.

deploybot: Canary progressed to 25% after 25m. No error spike.

kevin: Noticed a small increase in tokenization latency for longseq (0.9ms -> 2.5ms). Still within threshold but worth flagging.

alisa: If p99 latency crosses 300ms for >10m, we should pause. Set an alert and a manual pause step.

jamal: Agreed — adding manual hold at 60% for human check (10m). If everyone thumbs-up, proceed to 100%.

sre-oncall: Preparing runbook for fast rollback. Revert command:
```
# revert route to pinned runtime
redwoodctl routes update --service llm-quant --runtime pinned:v2.13.9 --force
```
Have monitoring ready: error-rate, p99, kv-cache-miss, OOM alerts.

prashant: Also note cost metric: quant runtime has +8% cpu on host. tagging finance so they can watch.

maria: LGTM for the plan. Oncall will watch first 90m.

alex: I'll be on standby to execute revert if needed. ping me @alex.

jamal: Thanks. GO for tonight's window unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

alisa: :thumbsup:

deploybot: Final status: rolled to 100% at 2025-03-23 01:40:12 UTC. Post-rollout checks running (2h window).

sre-oncall: Keep an eye on kv-cache miss spikes and memory OOMs — we saw a transient on canary but it didn't trigger. If we see repeat, we'll roll back.

maria: Noted. I'll update release notes with runtime/SDK compatibility caveat and rollback criteria.

jamal: Closing thread after 2h clean. Thanks folks.
